description: Send a prompt from the floating in-viewer field, or stop, fold / unfold (dismiss folds on desktop), or attach a viewer screenshot. Folding never cancels a run: the prompt slides behind a chevron at the bottom of the screen that shows the agent state (typing dots, working spinner, unread dot) and comes back exactly as it was. Does not edit a part and does not write git.

action.description: send is the default when text is present; fold hides the prompt behind the bottom chevron (dismiss does the same on desktop) and unfold brings it back as it was

text.description: Prompt text to send to the paired agent

name: agent_prompt
